title: Missing auth on WF update/delete post
description:
update_post and delete_post handlers lack proper authentication/authorization checks in two servers:

1. smallhold/src/writefreely_api.rs update_post (line 95): checks edit_token if provided, but if no token is sent AND article.edit_token is None, any unauthenticated request can update any post. No AuthenticatedAccount extractor is used.

2. smallhold/src/writefreely_api.rs delete_post (line 150): only validates edit_token if article has one. If article.edit_token is None, any request can delete any post without auth.

3. gaja/src/writefreely_api.rs update_post (line 54): no auth check at all. Any unauthenticated request can modify any post.

4. gaja/src/writefreely_api.rs delete_post (line 71): no auth check at all. Any unauthenticated request can delete any post.

Contrast with the create_post handlers in the same files which correctly require AuthenticatedAccount/AuthenticatedUser with write scope.

Locations:
- /home/mark/PROJECT/smallhold/src/writefreely_api.rs:95-171
- /home/mark/PROJECT/gaja/src/writefreely_api.rs:54-78
close_reason: Fixed: update_post and delete_post in both smallhold and gaja now require either valid edit token or authenticated user. Option<Auth> extractors added.
